scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @sutra/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @sutra/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sutra/shared && npm run build --workspace @sutra/backend && npm run build --workspace @sutra/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sutra/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @sutra/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sutra/frontend
